views.observation: Whole dark MRI/ctDNA matrix: enhancement and low/not-detected DNA can coexist, as can near-clean imaging and positive DNA. Low is conflated with negative; anatomy-lags-biology, two-signals-align and below-imaging-resolution are possible explanations rather than established mechanisms from the two tests. Best-aligned response needs temporal/context evidence. Final-answer wording overstates certainty because pathology and both assays have sampling limits. Unlabelled blood cells in the magnifier do not turn cell-free DNA into intracellular assay material.

Final-answer and mechanism captions retain the same uncertainty defect as dark; layout and top-cell glyphs change across themes.

Sleeping cells do not establish low turnover from a negative draw. Themes have materially different layouts.

views.observation: Whole dark Notch/Wnt cartoon: contact-dependent ligand/receptor and canonical secreted-Wnt/beta-catenin routes are distinguished. The NICD messenger is drawn outside/ambiguously relative to the receiving-cell border, rather than clearly released in its cytosol. Tip/stalk traffic analogy needs lateral-inhibition and context scope. A list of signalling-associated genes does not establish direction, activity or benefit. Same-clone biology is not a universal requirement for signalling between different cells.

views.observation: Whole light Notch/Wnt cartoon: tip GO/stalk STOP symbols can imply inactivity rather than different endothelial roles; NICD is unnamed as a generic released signal. The canonical beta-catenin branch omits co-receptor and destruction-complex steps. LIN28A is not itself a Wnt ligand or Frizzled receptor. Do not require all interacting cells to share a clone, or infer one pathway state from the displayed gene list. Light/dark geometry differs.

views.observation: Whole dark PPM cartoon: rare matched tumour signal versus not-detected, with explicit not-proof-of-zero-cells and sample-snapshot limits. The small icon field is not a million-fragment count or assay calibration, and1PPM is not a measured cell fraction or universal detection threshold. ctDNA is a subset of cell-free DNA, so the separate cfDNA label must mean other cfDNA in this drawing. The depicted tumour-match method is a specified example, not every assay.

views.observation: Whole light PPM cartoon: first-panel ctDNA is purple while the detected panel uses green, a semantic colour change across the example. Counts and one positive glyph cannot quantify1PPM. The negative snapshot does not establish absent disease, and a positive match needs the method, background/error rule and sampling context. The figure supplies no observed assay, trial result or recurrence probability; themes redraw layout and symbols.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole dark protein-building cartoon: presence, location and activity are useful separate questions. Overclaims are RPPA reads activation, all phosphorylation means activation, all IHC/mass-spec results establish intact protein/location, drugs bind protein and immune cells see protein without class scope. Never made contradicts subsequent degradation/misfolding/mislocalisation, which can follow synthesis. RNA is an actual RNA measurement rather than only a protein prediction. These overbroad captions are not adopted.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole light protein-building cartoon: same useful evidence-layer distinction and the same scalar overclaims as dark. Specific epitopes, peptides and sites have assay-dependent meanings; measured phosphorylation can be inhibitory and one signal need not show complete active protein or accessible target. Failed surface delivery is not proof no chain was made. The construction objects are schematic, not experimental outputs or treatment choices.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole dark RNA-architect cartoon: bulk RNA-seq counts messages recovered from a mixture, not pages per minute or direct current transcription/protein-function rates. scRNA-seq is sampled capture/assignment, not watching each actual architect/cell. Most pages not read today is an unquantified population-wide assertion. Expression, turnover, lineage and state are distinct, and noncoding RNA need not build protein. No literal room or architectural count is biology.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole light RNA-architect cartoon: same abundance-versus-rate and recovered-cell-versus-census issues as dark; one messenger carries a Page1 label despite the source master page being marked not read, a metaphor continuity detail. If not read nothing gets built is temporally too absolute for stable existing RNA/protein. Different cell types and states are not interchangeable labels; the analogy does not measure a tumour function. Themes redraw objects.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole dark autophagy-flow/dependence cartoon: RNA percentile, completed cargo handling, accumulated compartments and a separate dependence perturbation are distinguished. The90th percentile is a reference rank rather than activity, percent-positive cells or benefit. Cargo-return symbols do not establish secretion or universal product transport. A pathway block must be verified and need not be selective; more/less death or no change are hypotheses requiring proper controls, timing and restoration.

views.method: Fresh whole original-detail1536x1024 PNG view; no crop, browser, contrast measurement or accessibility test.
views.observation: Whole light autophagy cartoon: the productive route includes an open enclosure and a closed compartment, then a lysosome symbol, so completed autophagosome versus forming phagophore and post-fusion autolysosome remain simplified. Static accumulation does not uniquely diagnose blocked clearance. No-survival-change can reflect inadequate perturbation, timing or compensation, rather than proving irrelevance. All counts/percentiles and dish outcomes are illustrative, not observed assays; themes redraw quantities.
